title: Continued Fractions

entries.notes: Positive-real specialization of the source condition Re z > 0; finite convergents make the continued fraction's limit explicit. A proof-pending existential supplies the full coefficient sequence and its convergence; the reader-facing sequence is its Classical.choose.
The seven displayed coefficients are kept as one grouped source record; later coefficients are present in the existential full sequence because §5.10 refers to external tables for them.

shared_vocabulary_requests: Consolidate continuedFractionTail and continuedFractionConvergent if another section needs continued-fraction limits.
known_gaps: DLMF 5.10.1 is represented on the positive real axis rather than with the full complex general-logarithm branch convention.
DLMF 5.10.2 lists a₀ through a₆ and points to external tables for later coefficients. The existence assertion for a full sequence with those values and the E1 convergence/value remains proof-pending.
